qs.q: A 25-year-old primigravida at 36 weeks gestation receives counseling on birth preparedness and complication readiness. According to standard guidelines, which of the following is an essential component that must be included in her plan?
o: Booking an elective caesarean section date
Scheduling weekly antenatal visits until term
qs.e: A complete birth preparedness and complication readiness plan involves choosing a place of birth, saving money, arranging transport, identifying a blood donor, packing essentials, and knowing danger signs. Elective caesarean sections and frequent visits are not routine components of BP/CR.
